title: Drishyam 3 Drives Bollywood To Third-Strongest Monthly Box Office Performance Of 2026
text: Drishyam 3 Drives Bollywood to Third-Strongest Monthly Box Office Performance of 2026 | Zoom TV 03 Nov 2026 | 08:10 PM IST Zoom Zoom Hindi Switch to हिंदी Home Zoom Now Zoom WatchList Bollywood South Web Series Hollywood Korean Telly Talk Lifestyle Bizz Impact Photos Search Home Zoom Now Zoom WatchList Movies Latest Movies Upcoming Movies Web Series Latest Web Series Upcoming Web Series Language Genres Providers Bollywood South Web Series Hollywood Korean Telly Talk Lifestyle Bizz Impact Photos Live TV Travel Viral Short Videos Movies Reviews Web Stories Videos Home Bollywood Drishyam 3 Drives Bollywood To Third-Strongest Monthly Box Office Performance Of 2026 Ajay Devgn’s Drishyam 3 dominated the Indian box office in October 2026, contributing significantly to a cumulative monthly net of over 522 crore, marking the year's third-best performance for the industry. Zoom TV Digital Updated Nov 3, 2026, 20:06 IST The Indian box office experienced a steady October in 2026, largely propelled by the commercial success of the Ajay Devgn-led thriller, Drishyam 3. Following a period of recovery in September, the industry maintained momentum throughout the month, recording a cumulative net collection exceeding 522 crore. While this figure represents a slight decline compared to the previous month, it stands as the third-highest monthly total for Bollywood in 2026, trailing only the figures reported in March and September. The performance of the month was heavily concentrated on a single title, as no other release managed to surpass the 40 crore mark. The industry's reliance on the Drishyam franchise was evident, with the film serving as the primary driver for theater footfalls and revenue throughout its October run. Box Office Breakdown and Key Performers Released on October 2, Drishyam 3 emerged as the clear leader, securing a net collection of 376 crore within the month. The film benefited from significant audience interest, sustaining its momentum for several weeks and providing the bulk of the industry's total earnings. Its performance was instrumental in keeping the overall monthly figures robust despite a lack of high-performing competition. Outside of the top-performing title, other releases saw more modest returns. Ayushmann Khurrana’s project, Udta Teer, concluded the month with a net collection of 37.73 crore. Meanwhile, the film Hanuman Ansh, which has been in theaters since August, continued to draw audiences, adding 30.02 crore to the monthly tally. Several other films contributed to the cumulative total but remained below the 30 crore threshold, including Nayyi Navelli at 26.6 crore, Prahaar at 22.6 crore, and The Vvaan at 21.25 crore. Smaller contributions were recorded by Pehla Pyaar Doosri Baar (3.67 crore), Mirzapur The Movie (1.71 crore), Prem Keetanu (1.5 crore), and Vibe (1.14 crore). In total, Bollywood films generated 522.22 crore net at the Indian box office during October. This result reflects a 10.54% decrease from the 583.75 crore recorded in September. Despite this dip, the industry remains in a stable position as it moves toward the end of the year, with the overall 2026 performance highlighting the continued importance of major franchise releases in driving significant box office revenue.
